author: Codex delegated BeatLink production agent

design_authority.scope: concert aesthetic, role-based shared stage, phone controller, original product identity; no canonical performer cast specified

design_authority: Existing violet/magenta/cyan Stage Energy tokens and preserved original Link Room architecture

original_authorship.venues: Two hand-authored vector architectural environments: rooftop canopy/skyline/lantern terrace and enclosed acoustic shell/brass resonator hall. They are not renamed palette copies or real buildings. Existing Link Room pixels/paths unchanged.
original_authorship.performers: Three original articulated2D role representations with layered practical clothing, hair, face/hand detail, stage shoes, microphone/cable, percussion pad/stand/sticks and hype accessories. Source groups define actual rest geometry and joint transforms. Unnamed candidate representations of real seats, not approved fictional cast.
original_authorship.animation: Joint poses, beam angles and small light envelopes sampled deterministically from supplied calibrated room time, chart offset and BPM. Accepted score events anchor bounded perfect/great/good/miss response envelopes at observed game-clock time; no second song timer. Vocal mouth is tied to actual active/closing phrase window.
original_authorship.export_settings: Editable SVG1200x460 sRGB/vector, no embedded bitmap/external image/font. Performers are editable React SVG vector source with1200x460 stage coordinate overlay. No3D mesh/rig/Blender source is claimed.

runtime_integration.host: Cosmetic venue select available countdown/playing/paused/results, with actual connected role roster; existing lyrics and note lane outside scenery preserved.
runtime_integration.pause: Held calibrated pause elapsed snapshot retained; prior free-running haze/wash/countdown loops removed on this stage. No per-actor timers.
runtime_integration.reduced_motion: Existing settings reduceMotion and CSS media/document classes suppress pose/limb/head/haze movement; essential score/lyrics/phase info remains.
runtime_integration.score_authority: Presentation observes game.score_update only. No server score, authority, pitch exclusivity, provider rights or player controller logic changed.

limits: Source integration and author tests do not establish visible in-game quality. Runtime capture currently waits for root resource permission.
Stage is2D vector, not a3D venue/model/rig; normal gameplay camera and performance must still be assessed.
Host100ms server tick samples can produce held key poses; no measured AudioContext playhead/speaker latency is asserted.
ScoreEvent lacks exact note timestamp/unique outcome identity; VFX are anchored to observed accepted-event game time, not proven original contact time.
Existing badges, music rights and local-only approvals remain unchanged.
Outfits are role-family artwork, not a finished user customization system. Audience acting, full award choreography and further venue variety remain production work.
